meta.title: Vision tiler
meta.description: Reads high-resolution images through the segment_image tool: one overview plus overlapping tiles, so small text survives instead of being downscaled away. Each batch returns PNG attachments and a DeepSeek vision-token estimate. The tool is offered only for the models listed in its settings, so other providers keep their own image handling. Every call adds model requests and vision tokens; disable the plugin to remove the tool.
